mutant.name: P-M1-incomplete-page-guard-deleted
mutant.edit: the guard `else if newCovered != oldCovered || opaque_cursor == "" || pending_window_from != from || pending_window_to != to { return 422 GATE_FAILED "incomplete page may only advance its page cursor" }` was wrapped in `false && (...)` so it can never fire while every variable stays referenced
mutant.result: go test -count=1 -run ^TestW07 ./adapters/sources ./internal/domain ./tests/sources/live returned rc 0 with ZERO failing lines
mutant.restored: byte-for-byte (sha256 verified) and the clean re-run also returned rc 0

meaning: the accepted W07 adapter suite does not assert the direction the card's third action names. A test called TestW07CursorDoesNotAdvanceFailedOrUnpersistedWindow exists and passes, so the rule looks covered: it exercises the failed/unpersisted case, not the case where an incomplete page claims a covered window. Deleting the guard that refuses that claim is invisible to every check in the tree, including this card's.
why_no_test_was_written_here: an honest attempt needs the domain's own verifySourcePageChain to be satisfied first (the guard runs after it), which requires persisted source_pages and raw/evidence artifacts for the exact window; producing that without a real capture means either reusing the live probe (network, and the guard is only reachable from the adapter's page result) or building a multi-page stub whose base URL would have to be threaded through internal/domain and the frozen source_configs schema, which this card has no authority to change. Writing a shallow test that asserts a 422 on a hand-made body would either fail for the wrong reason or assert nothing about the guard, so it was not written.

obligation.ask: add a product-level construction that reaches the guard with a genuine two-page read - the cheapest credible route is a source adapter fixture whose second page exists, driving UpdateSourceCursor through the API with covered_until set and opaque_cursor non-nil, and asserting the exact message 'incomplete page may only advance its page cursor' - then keep P-M1 in the matrix as a required kill
obligation.owner: W07-01 (this card) if a two-page fixture can be built inside tests/sources/**, otherwise W07-02 or the source-adapter owner if the base URL must become configurable
